text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pe rkhidmatan Kewangan
(Pengecualian) 2019.

(2) Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 25 Mac 2019.

Pengecualian daripada subseksyen 8(1)

2. (1)  Anggota Kumpulan K elab Perlindungan dan Indemniti Antarabangsa
(IGP&I) dikecualikan daripada pemakaian subseksyen 8(1) Akta semata -mata bagi
maksud menjalankan perniagaan insurans berkenaan dengan insurans perlindungan dan
indemniti bagi kapal yang memiliki berat 5,000 tanan kasar atau kurang, termasuk kapal
Malaysia, bagi tempoh tiga tahun.

(2) Penanggung insurans yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual dikecualikan daripada
pemakaian subseksyen 8(1) Akta semata -mata bagi maksud  menjalankan perniagaan
insurans berkenaan dengan insurans perlindungan dan indemniti  bagi kapal Malaysia
yang memiliki berat 300 tanan kasar atau kurang bagi tempoh satu tahun.

 (3) Bagi maksud subperenggan (1) dan (2)—

(a) "insurans perlindungan dan indemniti " ertinya  insurans
perlindungan dan indemniti yang ditawarkan oleh  anggota
Kumpulan Kelab Perlindungan dan Indemniti Antarabangsa
(IGP&I) atau penanggung insurans yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual,
mengikut mana-mana yang berkenaan, secara usaha sama dengan
Perlindungan dan Indemniti Malaysia Sdn. Bhd.; dan

(b) "kapal Malaysia" mempunyai erti yang diberikan kepadanya
dalam subseksyen 11(1) Ordinan Perkapalan Saudagar 1952
[Ord. 70/1952].

JADUAL

1. MS Amlin Marine NV (dahulunya dikenali sebagai RaetsMarine Insurance B.V.),
penanggung insurans yang dilesenkan dan dikawal selia oleh  Pihak Berkuasa
Belanda bagi Pasaran Kewangan (Autoriteit Financiële Markten), Belanda

2. Archipelago Insurance Limited, penanggung insurans yang dilesenkan dan
dikawal selia oleh Lembaga Perkhidmatan Kewangan Labuan yang ditubuhkan
di bawah Akta Lembaga Perkhidmatan Kewangan Labuan 1996 [Akta 545]

Dibuat 26 Julai 2019
[MOF.SID(S)700-1/2/20; PN(PU2)718/V]

LIM GUAN ENG
Menteri Kewangan

FINANCIAL SERVICES ACT 2013

FINANCIAL SERVICES (EXEMPTION) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 263 of the
Financial Services Act 2013 [Act 758 ], the Minister, upon the recommendation of the
Bank, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Financial Services (Exemption)
Order 2019.

 (2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 25 March 2019.

Exemption from subsection 8(1)
2. (1) The members of the International Group of Protection and Indemnity Clubs
(IGP&I) are exempted from the application of subsection 8(1) of the Act for the purpose
of carrying on insurance business solely in respect of protection and indemnity insurance
for ships of 5 ,000 gross tonnage or less , including Malaysian ships , for a period of
three years.

 (2) The insurers specified in the Schedule are exempted from the application
of subsection 8(1) of the Act for the purpose of carrying on insurance business solely in
respect of protection and indemnity insurance for Malaysian ships of 300 gross tonnage
or less for a period of one year.

 (3) For the purposes of subparagraphs (1) and (2)—

(a) "protection and indemnity insurance" means the protection and
indemnity insurance offered by the members of the International
Group of Protection and Indemnity Clubs (IGP&I) or the insurers
specified in the Schedule, as the case may be,  in collaboration with
the Perlindungan dan Indemniti Malaysia Sdn. Bhd.; and

(b) "Malaysian ship" has the meaning assigned to it in subsection 11(1)
of the Merchant Shipping Ordinance 1952 [Ord. 70/1952].

SCHEDULE

1. MS Amlin Marine NV (formerly known as RaetsMarine Insurance B.V.), an insurer
licensed and regulated by the  Netherlands Authority for the Financial Markets
(Autoriteit Financiële Markten), Netherlands

2. Archipelago Insurance Limited, an insurer licensed and regulated by the Labuan
Financial Services Authority  established under the Labuan Financial Services
Authority Act 1996 [Act 545]

Made 26 July 2019
[MOF.SID(S)700-1/2/20; PN(PU2)718/V]

LIM GUAN ENG
Minister of Finance
